repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(not (any(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity <= 30))
triggered = false
}
wait until(any(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity <= 30)
all(#Switch).switch_on()
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait on a slot declared as `any` (existential). The candidate incorrectly used `all` (universal) in both the rearm and trigger conditions. Evidence F2 shows the IR acted on `Main_Humidifier` (where humidity was 0 <= 30) at t=0, but the JoI did not act because `all(#HumiditySensor)` required `Bedroom_HumiditySensor` (which was null) to also satisfy the condition. The fix replaces `all` with `any` to match the binding slot quantifier.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced `all(#HumiditySensor)` with `any(#HumiditySensor)` in the wait conditions. This aligns the JoI logic with the IR's existential quantifier over the `HumiditySensor` binding slot, allowing the action to fire when at least one sensor meets the condition, as observed in the counterexample.
